text: Breadth-first-search Input: An undirected, connected graph G. A start vertex v4 Output: T, a breadth-first search tree. AddvitoT. Add v, to the back of the list. While the list is not empty: Remove vertex v from the front of the list. For each neighbor w of v that is not already in T: Add w and {w, v}to T. Insert w at the back of the list. End-for End-while
